personal.name: Shivam Dubey
personal.headline: Electronics & VLSI Engineer
personal.summary: Detail-oriented Electronics Engineering student specializing in VLSI Design & Technology with a strong academic foundation (8.9 CGPA). Hands-on experience in IC design methodologies using Cadence Virtuoso, digital logic design, and hardware description languages (Verilog, SystemVerilog). Proven technical adaptability through an AI/ML internship at Lenovo, web development roles for IEEE, and embedded systems project prototyping.

education.degree: B.E. in Electronics Engineering — VLSI Design & Technology

education.institution: Fr. Agnel Multipurpose Higher Secondary School

projects.title: Footstep Energy Generation Using Piezoelectric Sensors
projects.tags: Piezoelectric Sensors • Embedded Systems • Renewable Energy
bullets: Designed and built an end-to-end prototype that harvests kinetic mechanical energy from footsteps and converts it to regulated electrical energy using piezoelectric sensors.
Configured energy storage circuits and analyzed low-power applications to establish efficient power management for sustainable IoT devices.

projects.title: Third Eye Smart Navigation System
projects.tags: Arduino Nano • Ultrasonic Sonar • Assistive Hardware
bullets: Engineered an assistive navigation system utilizing Arduino microcontrollers and ultrasonic sensors to detect obstacles in real-time.
Integrated synchronous buzzer and haptic vibration alert mechanisms to provide intuitive, low-latency feedback for visually impaired users.
Acquired practical experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning fundamentals, exploring core concepts including supervised learning, regression, and clustering algorithms.
Implemented data preprocessing and exploratory data analysis (EDA) techniques to handle datasets, improving analytical and troubleshooting methodologies.
Completed AI/ML-based assignments and practical projects, demonstrating strong engineering problem-solving and algorithmic implementation skills.

responsibility.organization: IEEE Student Branch — Goa College of Engineering
bullets: Manage, maintain, and deploy the official IEEE GEC website (ieee.gec.ac.in).
Coordinate the planning, communication, and technical infrastructure for college-wide IEEE events, workshops, and hackathons.
Collaborate with student council members and academic advisors to promote IEEE initiatives, boosting student registration and active event participation.
Leverage leadership, public communication, and project management skills to lead volunteer groups and organize technical training programs.
